> [!WARNING]
> **This is an alpha release.** Prism's feature set is in place and we are polishing it, so features and workflows can still change and you will run into bugs. It is not yet ready for production work. Keep backups of your models.

## Download

| System | File |
| --- | --- |
| Windows 10 and 11 (x64) | `Prism-windows-x64-Setup.exe` |
| macOS, Apple silicon | `Prism-macos-arm64.dmg` |
| macOS, Intel | `Prism-macos-x64.dmg` |
| Linux (Debian, Ubuntu) | `Prism-linux-x64.deb` |

Each file has a `.sha256` checksum next to it. Alpha builds are not code-signed or notarized: on Windows choose **More info › Run anyway** if SmartScreen warns you; on macOS right-click Prism and choose **Open** the first time. See the [install guide](https://chrizpro.github.io/prism/docs/download).

## Known issues

See [Known issues](https://chrizpro.github.io/prism/docs/reference/known-issues) for the current list, and [open bug reports](https://github.com/chrizpro/prism/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3Abug) on GitHub.

## Report a bug

Choose **Help (?) → Report a bug**. It opens the [bug form](https://github.com/chrizpro/prism/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) with your version and general system information filled in. Steps to reproduce and a small model that shows the problem help most. **Give feedback** is also in Help. Crash diagnostics are reviewed locally before opening GitHub; do not attach raw crash logs. Reports are public.

## Licenses

Prism is MIT-licensed. `Prism-LGPL-sources.zip` holds the source code of the LGPL libraries in this release (Open CASCADE Technology and Netgen). See [Credits and licenses](https://chrizpro.github.io/prism/docs/reference/credits).
